title: 第19章 无德胖子第20章 风起于青萍之末
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
长老席上，几位大人物正在讨论比赛的盛况。
二长老谈笑自若，目光看向身侧道：“沈风，你对这场比赛有何看法？”
此时沈风正坐在观赛席，作为冠军的最大热门，沈雷渊特地邀请其上台，显示出对他的欣赏。
面对几大长老，沈风不卑不亢道：“沈离在炼气六层沉淀了三年，已经将离火剑气修炼到小成，加上丰富的战斗经验，有冲击前三的实力。”
不褒不贬，评价极为中肯，获得在场之人的一致认同。
苏玉儿突然问道：“那沈云呢？”
沈风眉头微蹙，片刻后沉吟道：“观其气息有四层巅峰的修为，与沈离差距不小，不过沈云极有才情，加上沈秋族弟的珠玉在前，我觉得胜负应该是三七之分。”
听到他的分析，苏宇抚掌笑道：“有理有据，沈风小友当真是智勇双全。”
沈家几位长老也频频点头，能得到苏宇的夸奖，他们也与有荣焉。
苏玉儿白了他一眼，低声吐槽道：“什么破分析，哪个炼气四层能把我一招打晕。”
...
五长老心中也有同样的念头，‘这小子邪门的很，沈离应该是难了。
一声令下，沈离先下手为强，密集的脚步声响起，整个人形同鬼魅，眨眼间的功夫飞剑就已经横在沈云面前。
“太慢。”
沈云双手垂立，略微退了一步，飞剑直接落在了空处。
沈离再次挥剑，劈、刺、点、崩、击...剑招连连变换，观众们只能看到剑身的残影。
沈云一脸的轻松，脚下只是略微挪动，就避开了所有剑招，仿佛拿着卡尺计算，一分不多一分不少。
“好快的速度，好强的洞察力。”
沈离面色凝重，再也不复轻松写意，剑出如龙，火光四射，化作密集的剑网，要笼罩对方的所有退路。
面对铺天盖地的剑光，沈云不退反进，身形连闪如同电光乍现，飞剑在他面前好似龟爬。

大手一张灵力喷发，如同风暴的风眼，恐怖的冲击力席卷开来，将沈离吹的东倒西歪，费了九牛二虎之力才稳住了身形。
...
一番交手兔起鹊落，片刻之间沈离就落于下风。
观众们呼出一口气，沈云的表现完全出乎了他们的意料。
“好精妙的身法，我都看不清他的身影，连沈离都被压制了。”
“应该是小成境界的游云步，难以想象沈云修行只有一年时间，真的是令人叹为观止。”
“不仅如此，能轻易躲过沈离多次剑击，他的洞察力也非同一般。”
...
沈秋满脸的阴沉，心中晦暗：‘不愧是我最强的对手，只有击败这样的你才有价值。
沈卿若巧笑嫣然，美眸凝视着台上少年的身影，高声道：“沈云哥哥加油！”
...
content_en:
At the elders' table, several big shots were discussing the grand occasion of the competition.
The second elder talked and laughed calmly, looking to the side and saying: "Chen Feng, what do you think of this game?"
At this time, Shen Feng was sitting in the audience. As the favorite to win the championship, Shen Leiyuan specially invited him to the stage to show his appreciation for him.
Facing several elders, Shen Feng said neither humble nor arrogantly: "Shen Li has been at the sixth level of Qi Refining for three years. He has cultivated the Li Fire Sword Qi to a small degree. With his rich combat experience, he has the strength to hit the top three."
Neither praise nor blame, the evaluation was extremely pertinent and was unanimously recognized by everyone present.
Su Yu'er suddenly asked: "What about Shen Yun?"
Chen Feng frowned slightly, and after a moment he mused: "Judging from the fact that his aura has reached the fourth level of peak cultivation, he is far behind Shen Li. However, Chen Yun is extremely talented, and with the pearls and jade of the Shen Qiu clan brother in front, I think the winner should be 30-70."
After hearing his analysis, Su Yu clapped his hands and said with a smile: "It's reasonable and well-founded. Young friend Shen Feng is really wise and brave."
Several elders of the Shen family also nodded frequently, and they were honored to be praised by Su Yu.
Su Yu'er rolled her eyes at him and complained in a low voice: "What kind of analysis is this? Who at the fourth level of Qi Refining can knock me out with one move?"
...
The fifth elder also had the same thought in his mind, 'This kid is very evil, it should be difficult for Shen Li.
After giving the order, Shen Li struck first. The sound of dense footsteps sounded. His whole body looked like a ghost. In the blink of an eye, the Kung Fu flying sword was already lying in front of Shen Yun.
"Too slow."
Chen Yun lowered his hands, took a slight step back, and the flying sword landed directly in the air.
Shen Li swung his sword again, slashing, stabbing, hitting, collapsing, striking... The sword moves changed continuously, and the audience could only see the afterimage of the sword body.
Shen Yun looked relaxed. He just moved his feet slightly to avoid all the sword moves, as if he was calculating with a caliper, no more, no less.
"What a fast speed, what a strong insight."
Shen Li's face was solemn, he was no longer relaxed and free-spirited. The sword came out like a dragon, with fire radiating out, turning into a dense sword net, trying to cover all the opponent's escape routes.
Facing the overwhelming sword light, Chen Yun did not retreat but advanced, his body flashed like lightning, and the flying swords seemed to crawl in front of him.
The spiritual power erupted from his big hand, like the eye of a storm, and the terrifying impact swept across, knocking Shen Li to and fro, and it took a lot of effort to stabilize his figure.
...
After a fight, the rabbit rose and fell, and Shen Li was at a disadvantage in a moment.
The audience breathed a sigh of relief, Shen Yun's performance completely exceeded their expectations.
"What an exquisite movement. I can't even see his figure clearly. Even Shen Li was suppressed."
"It should be Youyunbu at the level of Xiaocheng. It's hard to imagine that Shen Yun has only been practicing for one year. It's really breathtaking."
"Not only that, he can easily avoid Shen Li's many sword strikes, and his insight is also extraordinary."
...
Shen Qiu's face was gloomy, and his heart was gloomy: "You are indeed my strongest opponent. Only by defeating you can you be valuable."
Shen Qingruo smiled sweetly, stared at the young man on the stage with her beautiful eyes, and said loudly: "Brother Shen Yun, come on!"
...
